title: Solid Leaves Pack
description: Prevents transparency bleed-through on Cherry (Sakura) and Pale Oak leaves for older resource packs. Most notably tested with Golden Days Alpha. No frills, just a fix.
body:
Ever loaded up your favorite old resource pack and noticed the Cherry or Pale Oak leaves looking completely see-through?

This fix pack exists for exactly that reason. Older resource packs built before Cherry (Sakura) and Pale Oak leaves were added to the game simply don't have textures for them, causing Minecraft to fall back on the vanilla transparent leaf rendering with no pack art to back it up. The result is an ugly, glitchy mess that breaks immersion.

So this pack fixes that.

Stack it on top of your existing resource pack and it will fill in solid, opaque textures for both leaf types, eliminating the transparency bleed-through entirely. It was built specifically with Golden Days Alpha in mind, and has been tested to look clean and cohesive alongside it.

It won't win any beauty contests. The textures are intentionally simple and designed to blend in rather than stand out. The goal isn't to look pretty, it's to fix one of the most common compatibility issues old packs run into with modern Minecraft.

Load order: place this pack above your main resource pack in the pack list to ensure it takes priority.
